newsitem.title: USA: Citadel stake increased by Lawndale group.
newsitem.headline: Citadel stake increased by Lawndale group.

text.p: A group led by Lawndale Capital Management LLC said Tuesday it raised its stake in Citadel Holding Corp to 9.6 percent or 579,000 common shares, from 8.0 percent or 479,200 shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 99,800 additional shares of Citadel between August 30 and October 28 at prices ranging from $2.406 to $2.588 each.
The group said it held its stake in Citadel for investment purposes. It said it has been in contact with Citadel's management to discuss the company's strategies to maximize shareholder value.
